title: Powergen Application Technic Service Manager
desc:
Job Description
As being one of the core brand of Rolls Royce Power Systems, Rolls Royce Solutions Türkiye is equipped with the experience of more than 100 years on productions of diesel engines, manufactures and improves complete drive systems, Gas and Diesel Systems and their control / monitoring systems in wide range of product types and power ratings for heavy vehicles and equipment for construction and mining industry.
We are looking for
Powergen Application Technic Service Manager
for İstanbul whom has the following qualifications.
Key Accountabilities
Orientation, training, development plans, referral and administration of the personnel under his responsibility.
Controlling and approval of application projects.
Establishing after-sales targets in line with company targets.
Implementation of application technics and after-sales pricing levels in line with the company's operational profitability targets.
Creating new areas and sales opportunities for the company in the market by offering application solutions that will make a difference
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher (Master’s/PhD preferred)
Having at least 5-7 years of relevant experience
Fluent speaking and writing in English
Proven track record of achieving targets
Strong leadership experience in managing multi-regional teams
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
Strong organizational, analytical, and relationship management capabilities
Proactive, results-oriented, and able to work independently
Type of Contract
Permanent
